description: Verify that DUT-emitted ARP Announcements have ARP target_hw = all zeroes (RFC 3927 §2.4, SHOULD)
approach:
[Objective]
RFC 3927 §2.4 says Announcements SHOULD set target_hw to all zeroes — like the Probe, the announcer is broadcasting a self-claim and does not have (or care about) a specific target hardware address. Setting target_hw to a real MAC would be misleading.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: OpStartLLAutoconf (kicks the Link-Local state machine)

2. DUT: 3 Probes → Announcement(s).

3. Observation:
   • DUT → wire: ARP Announcement
     - ARP target_hw == 00:00:00:00:00:00   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Announcement carries ARP target_hw = NULL_MAC.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_announce_target_hw_not_zero — Announcement target_hw is not the null MAC
• Fail_no_announce_after_probes — DUT did not emit any Announcement after the Probe phase

verdicts.Fail_no_announce_after_probes: DUT did not emit any ARP Announcement after Probes
